job.title: Paraplanner
job.description:
Paraplanner

Location: Liverpool (open to hybrid/remote working after onboarding)

Package: £50,000 basic + £10,000 bonus (c.£60,000 package)

My client is a rapidly growing international wealth management business building a high-performing UK paraplanning function around quality, consistency and technology. The business supports both UK and internationally mobile clients and is investing heavily in systems that reduce lower-value administration so technical professionals can spend more time on analysis, strategy and adviser partnership. This opportunity is designed for an experienced Level 4 Paraplanner who wants strong technical exposure, remote flexibility and a credible route into advice.

The Role

  • Work in a close support pod alongside Financial Advisers and Administrators, taking ownership of the technical planning work behind client recommendations.
  • Analyse fact finds, objectives, existing arrangements and client circumstances to identify planning considerations, information gaps and suitable strategies.
  • Prepare clear, compliant and client-friendly suitability reports, financial planning documentation and supporting research.
  • Provide technical support across pensions and retirement planning, including defined benefit and defined contribution knowledge, drawdown, investments, tax-aware structuring and inheritance / estate planning considerations.
  • Use cashflow modelling and digital planning tools to test scenarios, illustrate outcomes and strengthen the planning conversation.
  • Work collaboratively with advisers, compliance and specialist teams on more complex cases, including clients with cross-border or expatriate circumstances.
  • Contribute to improving templates, processes and technology as the UK paraplanning function continues to scale.

About You

  • Level 4 Diploma qualified as a minimum.
  • Around 4+ years of genuine UK paraplanning / technical financial planning experience.
  • Strong knowledge of retirement planning, drawdown, DB and DC pensions, investments, inheritance planning and cashflow modelling.
  • Excellent written skills, technical judgement and attention to detail, with the confidence to challenge or refine an adviser strategy where appropriate.
  • Experience with international / expatriate clients, QROPS or cross-border planning would be highly attractive but is not essential.
  • Ambitious, collaborative and comfortable working in a fast-paced business that is growing quickly and continuing to modernise its advice process.

Package & Progression

  • £50,000 basic salary plus a £10,000 performance bonus, giving a target package of approximately £60,000.
  • Full support for further professional qualifications and technical development.
  • A clear progression route into Financial Advice / client servicing for those who want to move beyond Paraplanning.
  • Exposure to a modern, technology-enabled advice platform and a client base that includes complex UK and internationally mobile wealth.

My client is particularly interested in speaking with ambitious, entrepreneurial Financial Advisers who want the security of an excellent employed package today, while retaining the opportunity to build considerably greater earnings and ownership over their client relationships in the future.

job.title: IFA Administrator
job.description:
IFA Administrator
Location: Lichfield
Package: Circa £30,000 basic + 20% bonus (c.£36,000 target package)
My client is a fast-growing, adviser-led wealth management business with a substantial UK and international footprint. The firm combines regulated financial planning with modern technology, specialist support and a strong client-service culture, and is continuing to expand through both organic hiring and acquisitions. As part of that growth, it is strengthening its administration capability across the West Midlands and is looking for an experienced IFA Administrator who wants both responsibility and a genuine long-term career path.
The Role
• Provide end-to-end administrative support to Financial Advisers and Paraplanners across a busy UK financial planning caseload.
• Manage client onboarding, letters of authority, account opening, new business processing, transfers, withdrawals and ongoing servicing.
• Liaise professionally with clients, product providers, platforms and internal teams, ensuring outstanding information and actions are progressed promptly.
• Prepare valuations, review packs, client documents and supporting information ahead of adviser meetings.
• Maintain complete and accurate client records, CRM data, file notes and documentation in line with FCA and internal compliance standards.
• Track cases through to completion, identifying delays or missing information and taking ownership of follow-up.
• Work closely within an adviser / paraplanner / administrator structure to help advisers spend more time with clients and less time on administration.
About You
• Around 2+ years of experience within a UK IFA, financial planning or wealth management administration environment.
• Good working knowledge of pensions, investments, platforms and the client review / new business process.
• Strong organisation, accuracy and written communication, with confidence managing multiple cases and deadlines.
• Comfortable using CRM, document-management and financial planning systems.
• A client-first, proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership rather than simply pass tasks on.
• Experience supporting internationally mobile, expatriate or US-connected clients in a UK planning environment would be useful, but is not essential.
Package & Progression
• Circa £30,000 basic salary plus a 20% performance bonus, taking target earnings to approximately £36,000.
• Support towards relevant professional qualifications and structured development.
• Clear progression into Paraplanning for technically minded administrators, with a longer-term route into Financial Advice for those who want it.
• Exposure to a growing client base, modern planning technology and a business investing heavily in its people, systems and UK growth.

job.title: Financial Advisor — Annecy, France
job.description:
Financial Advisor — Annecy, France
Salary: €150,000 per annum
Location: Annecy, France

James & Partners Talent is recruiting a Financial Advisor for an established international wealth management business specialising in financial planning for British nationals living in, moving to and returning from Europe.

Based in Annecy, you will join the firm’s French advisory operation, combining responsibility for existing client relationships with a clear focus on attracting new clients and growing assets under advice. The opportunity offers an established professional platform, company-generated enquiries and access to specialist technical support.

The client proposition brings together investment planning, pensions, tax and estate planning, with particular emphasis on the interaction between clients’ UK financial affairs and their lives in France.

The role


  • Develop new client relationships through marketing enquiries, referrals and your own professional networks.

  • Convert enquiries into financial-planning engagements and ongoing advisory relationships.

  • Review existing clients’ circumstances, objectives and portfolios, identifying suitable opportunities for additional investment.

  • Work with tax, pension and investment specialists on financial-planning needs involving both France and the UK.

  • Help clients understand their options around retirement income, investment structures and succession planning.

  • Maintain clear suitability records, accurate client information and consistent follow-up.

  • Work closely with the French regional team and central enquiry team to progress opportunities.

  • Build relationships that generate repeat business and introductions over time.

Your background


  • A minimum Level 4 Diploma in Financial Planning or Regulated Financial Planning.

  • Level 6 qualifications or Chartered status would be advantageous.

  • Experience providing regulated financial advice to private clients.

  • A demonstrable record of winning clients, developing referrals and converting enquiries into business.

  • Sound knowledge of investment planning, pensions, risk assessment and suitability.

  • Experience advising UK clients; expatriate or cross-border experience would be particularly relevant.

  • Knowledge of the French financial-planning environment would be beneficial.

  • Strong organisation, communication and digital record-keeping skills.

The opportunity

You will have access to existing client relationships, marketing support, paraplanning, administration and specialist technical teams. Structured induction, mentoring and continuing development support advisors as they establish themselves within the business.

There is no requirement to bring a transferable client book.

The position is linked to the Annecy office and combines office contact with client meetings and home working where appropriate. Travel and working patterns depend on the client base. It is not a fully remote appointment.

To apply, please submit your CV to James & Partners Talent, outlining your qualifications, advisory experience and current location. All enquiries will be handled confidentially.

job.title: Private Client Manager — Cascais, Portugal
job.description:
Private Client Manager — Cascais, Portugal
Salary: €120,000 per annum
Location: Cascais, Portugal

James & Partners Talent is recruiting a Private Client Manager for an established international wealth management business in Cascais.

This is an advisory and relationship-management position focused on an existing portfolio of private clients. You will provide regular reviews, maintain continuity of service and ensure financial plans remain appropriate as clients’ circumstances, objectives and needs change.

The firm supports British nationals and expatriate families with investment planning, pensions, tax and estate planning. Its Cascais office serves clients across the Lisbon area and wider territories including the Silver Coast, Porto, Northern Portugal and Madeira.

The role


  • Take responsibility for an established portfolio of private-client relationships.

  • Conduct thorough financial reviews covering income, expenditure, investments, pensions, objectives and attitude to risk.

  • Assess whether changes in clients’ lives or financial circumstances require adjustments to their plans.

  • Explain portfolio performance, income projections and recommendations clearly.

  • Implement agreed recommendations in conjunction with partners, administration and specialist teams.

  • Maintain accurate financial plans, client records and suitability documentation.

  • Keep clients informed about developments relevant to their arrangements.

  • Identify appropriate additional investments and generate referrals through strong ongoing service.

  • Coordinate meetings, reviews and follow-up actions to maintain a consistent client experience.

Your background


  • A minimum Level 4 qualification in Regulated Financial Planning, or a relevant international equivalent.

  • At least five years’ financial-services experience, primarily within investment advice and wealth management.

  • A proven record of delivering competent financial advice and maintaining long-term client relationships.

  • Experience advising clients with approximately £1 million–£5 million in investable assets, or the equivalent in other currencies.

  • Strong knowledge of investment suitability, risk assessment, pensions and wider financial planning.

  • Confidence using investment platforms, risk-profiling tools and client-management systems.

  • Excellent listening skills, attention to detail and a reliable approach to client commitments.

  • Overseas investment-market experience and familiarity with UK–Portugal financial-planning needs would be advantageous.

The opportunity

The role offers substantial responsibility for ongoing client relationships, supported by partners, administration, paraplanning and specialist technical resources.

Your commercial contribution will come primarily through effective client servicing, appropriate additional investment and referrals. The position will suit an experienced advisor who enjoys detailed planning, regular client contact and managing an established portfolio.

Full in-house training is provided, with reasonable training expenses covered. A transferable client book is not required.

The appointment is linked to the Cascais office. Client meetings and travel will depend on the portfolio assigned, with home working where appropriate and regular office contact. It is not fully remote.

Please submit your CV to James & Partners Talent, outlining your qualifications, private-client experience and current location. All applications will be treated confidentially.

  • Build local professional relationships and contribute to the development of the Cyprus business.

  • Strong investment, pension and financial-planning knowledge.

  • The ability to communicate complex matters clearly and build confidence with clients.

  • Experience with UK private clients; international or expatriate advisory experience would be valuable.

  • A disciplined approach to suitability, record keeping and client service.

job.title: Residential Valuation Surveyor
job.description:
Residential Valuation Surveyor – Associate Director / Senior Associate Director / Director / Senior Director

Location: London – Prime Central London, Greater London & Home Counties

Salary: Dependent on level of seniority but Director-level appointments anticipated at up to £85,000 (negotiable depending on experience)

Car Allowance: £5,500–£8,500 depending on seniority

Additional Benefits: Performance Bonus, Private Medical Insurance, Pension, Up to 30 Days' Annual Leave & Extensive Corporate Benefits

The Opportunity:

I am delighted to be partnering with one of the United Kingdom's most distinguished and established property consultancies, as they look to make several senior appointments within their highly regarded London Residential Valuation division.

With opportunities spanning Associate Director through to Senior Director, these appointments offer accomplished Chartered Surveyors the opportunity to work at the upper end of the residential property market, advising on some of London's most significant private residences, high-value residential investments, historic properties and development opportunities.

Operating across Prime and Super-Prime Central London, Greater London and the Home Counties, the team provides independent valuation advice across an exceptionally varied portfolio of residential assets, often involving complex ownership arrangements, unusual tenure structures and substantial capital values.

These are appointments for individuals who value technical excellence, professional independence and the opportunity to develop lasting relationships with a sophisticated client base.

For more senior individuals, there is considerable scope to influence the future direction of the valuation practice, develop new client relationships and play a leading role in the continued growth of an already established and highly respected business.

About the Business

With a heritage spanning more than 140 years, my client is one of Britain's most respected names in property, having built an enviable reputation for the quality of its advice, the calibre of its people and the enduring relationships it maintains with its clients.

Established in the nineteenth century, the business has evolved into a prominent national property consultancy, combining the traditions and personal service of a heritage practice with the resources, professional capabilities and market intelligence of a major property advisory organisation.

Its expertise encompasses Prime Residential Property, Country Houses, Historic Estates, Rural Land Management, Development, Investment and Professional Valuation Services.

The firm advises an established and discerning client base that includes private individuals, high-net-worth families, landed estates, trustees, institutional investors, developers, lenders and corporate organisations.

Its work extends from some of the capital's most desirable residential addresses to substantial country houses, historic buildings, residential investment portfolios and complex development assets throughout the United Kingdom.

The valuation practice is supported by an extensive national network of RICS Registered Valuers, alongside established agency, residential development, planning and rural property specialists.

This breadth of expertise provides a particularly attractive professional environment, where complex valuations are informed by specialist market knowledge, transactional evidence and an exceptionally broad understanding of UK property.

Despite its national standing, the business retains a culture centred on individual expertise, considered professional advice and long-term client relationships.

The Position:

Joining the London Residential Valuation team, which forms part of the firm's wider Rural and Professional Services business, you will undertake a sophisticated range of valuation instructions across Prime Central London, Greater London and the surrounding Home Counties.

The work encompasses a broad spectrum of residential property, including substantial period townhouses, luxury apartments, listed and architecturally significant residences, high-value residential investments, development sites and properties involving complex legal or occupational arrangements.

Instructions will be undertaken for a variety of purposes, including secured lending, investment, acquisition and disposal, taxation, estate planning, matrimonial matters and other specialist advisory requirements.

Working alongside experienced colleagues and an established national valuation network, you will provide technically robust, carefully researched and commercially considered valuation advice.

Depending on your experience and level of appointment, you will also assume responsibility for managing key client relationships, overseeing complex instructions, mentoring colleagues and contributing to the strategic development and commercial performance of the department.

Key Responsibilities

  • Undertake and deliver comprehensive residential valuations in accordance with the RICS Valuation – Global Standards (Red Book), ensuring the highest standards of technical accuracy, independence and professional integrity.
  • Advise on an extensive variety of high-value residential assets, including Prime and Super-Prime London properties, residential portfolios, development opportunities and properties held under complex tenure arrangements.
  • Manage instructions from initial client engagement and inspection through to valuation analysis, reporting and final delivery.
  • Provide considered and well-supported valuation opinions, drawing upon market evidence, financial analysis, professional judgement and detailed knowledge of the residential property market.
  • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with private clients, banks, financial institutions, developers, solicitors and other professional advisers.
  • Take responsibility for the quality, accuracy and timely completion of valuation reports, ensuring full compliance with professional standards and internal governance requirements.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's client portfolio, identifying opportunities for new instructions and strengthening existing relationships.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Residential Agency, Rural Consultancy, Development, Planning and other specialist property disciplines.
  • Support the commercial performance of the department through effective instruction management, fee generation and considered business development activity.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of valuation methodologies, technical procedures and professional standards.

For appointments at Director and Senior Director level, the position will carry broader leadership, technical and commercial responsibilities.

These are opportunities for established professionals seeking meaningful influence within a highly regarded national consultancy.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Providing senior technical oversight and final review of complex, high-value or higher-risk valuation instructions.
  • Acting as a senior professional authority on residential valuation matters, advising colleagues on particularly challenging or specialist instructions.
  • Taking ownership of key institutional, lender and private client relationships.
  • Leading business development initiatives, securing new instructions and supporting the long-term expansion of the London valuation practice.
  • Providing professional leadership, mentoring and technical guidance to colleagues across the wider team.
  • Overseeing quality assurance, compliance and valuation risk management.
  • Contributing to departmental strategy, financial performance and operational development.
  • Representing the business at senior client meetings, professional events and within the wider property industry.

About You:

My client is interested in speaking with accomplished residential valuation professionals at varying stages of their senior careers.

Whether you are an established Associate Director seeking broader exposure to the Prime London market, a Senior Associate Director looking for progression, or an experienced Director considering a more influential leadership appointment, there is flexibility to shape the opportunity around the right individual.

Candidates should demonstrate:

  • MRICS qualification and current RICS Registered Valuer status.
  • A strong professional background in residential valuation, ideally gained within an established property consultancy, surveying practice or relevant client-side environment.
  • Experience advising on a broad range of residential assets, with exposure to Prime London, high-value residential property or complex valuation instructions particularly advantageous.
  • A sound understanding of residential development valuations, development appraisal and the factors influencing development potential.
  • Excellent technical knowledge of RICS valuation standards and associated professional requirements.
  • The ability to produce articulate, carefully reasoned and technically robust valuation reports.
  • Strong commercial judgement, attention to detail and an appreciation of the discretion required when advising high-profile private and institutional clients.
  • An established professional network, together with the ability to nurture relationships and identify commercial opportunities.
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to engage with clients and professional advisers at a senior level.
  • Strong organisational capabilities, with the ability to manage competing instructions and demanding deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience of Argus Developer or other professional valuation software advantageous.
  • A relevant degree and full UK driving licence.

For more senior appointments, demonstrable experience of technical leadership, business generation, team development and managing significant client relationships will be particularly valued.

Package:

My client recognises the importance of attracting and retaining accomplished professionals and offers a comprehensive remuneration and benefits package, reflective of both the seniority of these appointments and the standing of the business.

Basic Salary

Director-level appointments are initially anticipated at approximately £80,000–£85,000, although remuneration will be considered in the context of an individual's experience, professional standing and the value they can bring to the practice.

Packages for Associate Director, Senior Associate Director and Senior Director appointments will be discussed individually.

  • Associate Director – £5,500 per annum

Financial & Protection Benefits

  • Performance-related bonus scheme

  • Open Fairways golf membership and Perks at Work

Professional Development & Culture

  • Access to an extensive programme of learning and continuing professional development
  • Opportunity to work alongside experienced specialists across multiple property disciplines
  • An established platform for long-term career progression and professional recognition
  • An active programme of company sporting, social and charitable events

All enquiries will be handled in the strictest confidence.
